title: Media in Templates: Image Resizing, Asset URLs and Tag Helpers | Orchard Core
description:
A media field stores the path of a file in the media library, and a template has to turn that path into a URL, often for an image of another size.

The Media module maps a path to a public URL, resizes images on request through signed URLs, and offers the same options in Liquid filters, Razor helpers, and tag helpers.

In this video:
• From a path to an image: asset URLs, resize commands, tokens, and the cache
• Liquid filters: asset_url, img_tag, and resize_url
• Media profiles: resize commands under a name
• Razor helpers: AssetUrl and AssetProfileUrlAsync
• Tag helpers: asset-src, the img attributes, and asset-href
• The result in the browser: one image, five renditions
• Versions and the image engine: cache busting and a custom engine
